user.title: Connect a JugglucoNG phone
user.description: Home Assistant will receive glucose data from JugglucoNG on this phone. Give the phone a name, such as My phone. Add each phone separately.

receiver.title: Save the phone connection
receiver.description:
Choose your settings and submit this form to activate the connection. Then open Configure for this phone on the Glucifer HA integration page to display its QR code.

To connect away from home, use a reachable HTTPS address or VPN and leave Accept local requests only turned off.

init.title: Phone connection settings
init.description:
This connection is ready to receive data. In JugglucoNG, open API destinations, add Glucifer HA, and scan the QR code below or paste this connection URL:

`{url}`

Turn the destination on and choose which data to send. JugglucoNG saves changes automatically. Tap Send test message and check Last success, then tap Done.

You can close this HA dialog after scanning. Submit only if you changed the settings below. If only a URL path is shown, add your Home Assistant URL before it. Keep the URL and QR code private.

rotate.title: Replace the connection URL
rotate.description:
Submit to activate this new connection URL and disable the old one. Then update the Glucifer HA destination in JugglucoNG using the QR code below or this URL. Your entities and stored readings are kept.

`{url}`

Keep the URL and QR code private.
